newsitem.title: USA: Intraday CSCE world sugar lower and rangebound.
newsitem.headline: Intraday CSCE world sugar lower and rangebound.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures were trading barely weaker in thin and rangebound trade, dealers said.
At 1130 EDT, the benchmark October contract was 0.03 cent lower at 11.29 cents per lb, while spot July stood down 0.03 at 11.39 cents.
Volume at 1100 EDT was estimated at 10,499 lots.
"The trade is buying July and selling October and the specs are on the other side of the coin," a floor source said, adding that the market has probably set its daily range.
The expiry of the July contract on June 30 is expected to remain orderly despite a large open interest in July.
Non-commercial long are believed to represent a hefty proportion of the 62,333 lots of open interest remaining on the July contract as of early Friday, dealers said.
The July/October spread should narrow to around 0.05 cent by the end of the week. At 1130 EDT, July was trading at an 0.08 cent premium to October, compared with 0.10 cent on Friday.
